evidence.title: Saudara AI on the cash-flow gap in global sourcing
evidence.text:
💸 The biggest problem in global sourcing isn't the factories. It's cash flow.
Brands need payment terms so they can sell inventory before cash leaves the business. 🏭 Factories need deposits upfront to buy raw materials, pay workers, and carry the production risk.
Both sides are right. ✅ And that mismatch is one of the hidden reasons the best sourcing agents are worth so much.
Because the great ones don't just find factories. They bridge trust, financing, and payment timing between both sides. 🤝
🤖 This is where AI gets powerful. Faster buyer underwriting, smarter risk prediction, stronger supplier reliability signals, and financing decisions that actually make sense. Better terms for brands, more confidence for factories.
That's the sourcing infrastructure we're building at Saudara. Faster, smarter, and easier for everyone involved. 🚀
💬 Have you ever hit a cash flow mismatch when sourcing or paying suppliers? Drop a comment and tell me how you handled it.
Starting a brand or sourcing products globally? Start with Saudara. Link in bio. 🔗
#GlobalSourcing #SupplyChain #EcommerceBusiness #StartupJourney #AIinBusiness

details.detail: Known company and founder handles could be verified through public native feed and oEmbed endpoints without login.

Instagram native account search returned HTTP 401 for the public query 'Aktoria Robotics'. The current roster has no Instagram inventory, official YC/company pages yielded no ownership links, and public web search yielded only third-party posts, so login-gated native account discovery remains a blocker for exhaustive S26 coverage.
The lack of roster-linked handles and strict public post leads is an independent blocker; a login alone would not make third-party or unattributed rows acceptable.
